High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioners have come to this Court for setting aside the proceedings initiated against them pertaining to Crime No.921/2016 for the offence under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.

Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned Government Advocate for the State submits that the respondents have filed their reply in which they have categorically stated that vide judgment dated 24.6.2022 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Harda, the trial is already concluded and nothing survives for adjudication in this petition.
In view of the aforesaid, this petition is disposed of as having been rendered infructuous.
